layers.state: Pool {initialized,target,backstop,watcherReserve,epoch,seatBySlot,meterBySlot,payoutBySlot}; fixed slot maps prepopulated with present bool; QA {actionHits,claimCount,backstopCredits,watcherCredits,watcherDebits,transferHistory,initialBalances,maxHistoricalTarget}. Environment {maturity,importedFacts} distinct from product state.
layers.functional: pure canX(Pool,args,Environment) -> bool; pure applyX(Pool,args) -> Pool; independent expectedEffectsX(before,args) -> List[Effect].
layers.actions: Guard then assignment only. No reject/no-op fallback in step; failed calls tested as disabled predicates and actual Core Err with no committed effects.
layers.atomicity: One accepted actual Core action equals one Quint transition; compare full intermediate statement snapshots separately because next updates are immediate in Core.

invariants.name: accountingConservation
invariants.predicate: gross = all cost entitlement amounts + all operator/DA/treasury entitlement amounts + cumulative backstop credit + watcher credit + unallocated operator/DA remainder (pre-settle carry=gross-metered)

invariants.name: custodyConservation
invariants.predicate: initial exact-asset pool balance + accepted intake transfers = current pool balance + cumulative actual outgoing exact-asset Transfer/Fee effects; duties and funds counted in separate equations
invariants.nonvacuity: positive incoming/outgoing effects; immutable expected full sequence

invariants.name: costsFirst
invariants.predicate: sum original cost entitlements = metered <= gross; splits use gross-metered; cost claim blocked until epoch settled

invariants.name: fixedOriginalWeight
invariants.predicate: each allocated amount=floor(originalCategoryTotal*effectiveSeatWeight/max(originalAggregateWeight,1)); totals and weights immutable after settle; sum allocations<=total
invariants.nonvacuity: weights1/2 with55 gives18/36 and residue1; reverse order identical

invariants.name: noDoubleClaim
invariants.predicate: claimCount[k]<=1; claimed implies present positive payout; consumed duty cannot reappear; failed replay has no effects
invariants.nonvacuity: one successful then one repeated actual claim

invariants.name: noCrossStream
invariants.predicate: every financial effect uses configured exact AssetId and literal source/recipient; other-asset balances and unrelated duties unchanged; source has no separate capacity/burn intake API, but intake economic provenance remains an authenticated-import premise
invariants.nonvacuity: two assets in real Scenario with nonzero sentinel; wrong-asset substitutions refuse or leave sentinel unchanged

invariants.name: reserveHeld
invariants.predicate: watcherReserve + cumulative watcher-spend entitlements = cumulative5% watcher credits; watcher reward seat allocation disabled; stipends consume gross via meters, never reserve
invariants.nonvacuity: credit5 and spend3 leaves2; stipend exists separately

invariants.name: backstopRoute
invariants.predicate: each refill=min(amount,max(target-beforeBalance,0)); no withdrawal on target decrease; balance<=max(initialBalance,all historical targets); L2 receives amount-refill
invariants.nonvacuity: initial target17,settle refill15,finish refill2; target lowering case

invariants.name: residualSweep
invariants.predicate: finished implies all reward slots allocated and remainders0; finish payout+finish refill=pre-finish remainder; second finish disabled
invariants.nonvacuity: zero-weight DA leaves10 and unequal operator floors leave1

invariants.name: vestingConditional
invariants.predicate: reward unlock=epochClose+2592000 and claimTime>=unlock; ordinary/treasury/watcher unlock=epochClose; valid only under explicit authenticated-clock premise for source correspondence
invariants.nonvacuity: early disabled then exact-boundary accepted in reference model; actual profile must disclose missing binding

invariants.name: recipientBindingConditional
invariants.predicate: claim output/Transfer exact frozen entitlement recipient and amount; foreign claimant disabled only if real source provides claim authority, otherwise external authorization premise remains open
invariants.nonvacuity: wrong account mutation and full expected effects

invariants.name: frozenInputsAndUniqueSlots
invariants.predicate: meter/roster immutable after settle; header/receipt/seat/payout fresh; ordinary and reserve receipt identities disjoint or global replay-rejected
invariants.nonvacuity: post-settle meter/register and cross-kind receipt replay negatives

premises: Genesis is atomically initialized before public use; nonzero authority/asset/treasury identities; federated mode. A constructor or Scenario seed is not demonstrated deployment.
Imported canonical header, revenue escrow, attestation/uptime, DA weights, metered costs and fraud/inclusion evidence are true and asset-normalized. No foreign-proof importer is established.
Source cannot replace authority with caller supplied Bool and count it as cryptographic authentication. Existing signed-call relation/native authorization gates remain separate.
Clock freshness/monotonicity and ledger time binding are external until actual frozen source/native path enforces them. Caller supplied now is not authenticated time.
Literal account/slot specialization abstracts hash-domain separation and recipient secret commitments; real recipient authentication and cross-instance hash uniqueness are not proven.

Model conservation describes monetary accounting. Actual withdrawal acceptance requires actual complete Transfer effects, native output binding and real ledger evidence; Core simulate or compile success is not settlement.
No slashing, graduation weighting, governance truth/valuation, source signal_step_down, general dynamic registries or multi-epoch/multi-instance import replay coverage in finite M11 monetary profile.

Exact AssetId isolation does not prove economic revenue origin: record_epoch imports a gross amount, and source cannot determine whether canonical importer included forbidden capacity proceeds or used the wrong economic token. This remains external import evidence.

correspondence_plan: Freeze actual .mori bytes, public Program JSON, full static compile artifacts and exported action names before writing model adapter; map each public state/input/action/effect to one named Quint field/transition.

For every deterministic scenario calculate expected state/duties/transfers independently from pinned arithmetic vectors and pure model, then execute actual parse/validate/simulate action; compare all pre/post state, balances, liabilities, ordered effects including kind/asset/from/to/amount, and emitted values.

For each disabled guard run actual source action and require a coded refusal with no committed snapshot/effects; never accept host success flag, unchecked q, omitted effect or synthetic signature as correspondence.

Check statement snapshots for immediate next/read semantics and witness equations before financial effects. Inspect static public constraints for q,d,r bounds, positive d and r<d along every action that consumes division witnesses.

Include contrasting source that changes one share or recipient; unchanged inputs must produce expected behavioral/complete-effect divergence. Compile both actual Programs through existing static route only; no proving or native dispatch.

Record source/Program/model/expected artifact hashes, concrete instance bounds, commands, seed, exact Quint version/backend, sample count, witness counts, failures and terminal trace lengths. Passing sampled runs establish only bounded sampled model evidence.
